title: Rooms
description: The physical layout of your space: rooms and how many desks each one has. Prices are set in Plans.

importExport.comingSoonDesc: CSV import/export for rooms & desks is on the roadmap.

desksCard.title: Rooms & desks
desksCard.subtitle: The bookable desk areas in your space. Open a room to change its desks or labels.
desksCard.noRoomsNote: No rooms yet. Add your first room and choose how many desks it contains.
desksCard.upcomingBookingsNote: Reducing desks or deleting a room with upcoming bookings is blocked until those bookings are moved or cancelled.

roomEditor.description: Set the room name and desks available for booking.

deleteRoomAlert.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteRoomAlert.descWithDesks: This removes the room and its {{count}} desk.
deleteRoomAlert.descWithDesks_plural: This removes the room and its {{count}} desks.
deleteRoomAlert.blockedNotice: Upcoming bookings will block the deletion.

meetingRoomsCard.title: Meeting rooms
meetingRoomsCard.subtitle: Bookable by the hour. Set a name and an hourly rate — the rate shows on the public booking page.
meetingRoomsCard.noMeetingRoomsNote: No meeting rooms yet. Add one below — capacity defaults to 4 and is editable later.

meetingRoomDialog.description: Set the public name, seat count, hourly rate, and booking limits.
meetingRoomDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Shown to visitors once they pick this room — e.g. what's included, conditions.
meetingRoomDialog.hoursInvalid: Closing time must be after opening time.
meetingRoomDialog.freeWithDesk: Make hourly bookings free with an active desk booking
meetingRoomDialog.freeWithDeskHelp: Same member and date only. Whole-day and multi-day bookings always use their tariff.
meetingRoomDialog.allowWholeDay: Allow whole-day booking (single or multiple days, at a flat price)

deleteMeetingRoomAlert.title: Delete "{{name}}"?
deleteMeetingRoomAlert.description: The room is removed immediately. Past hourly bookings stay on record; future ones are cancelled.

toasts.cannotReduceDesksDesc: Some desks have upcoming bookings. Reassign or cancel them first.
toasts.cannotDeleteRoomDesc: Desks in this room have upcoming bookings. Reassign or cancel them first.
